parameters: \rZinnia: At last we reach the final chapter…
\rA thousand years of peace followed after that disastrous time.
\rBut the Draconid people, learning from their long history's cyclical nature, foretold that the meteoroids would fall on this land again.
\rThe meteoroid to come, they prophesized, would be far greater than those that had come before it.
\rThis meteoroid would be great enough to break the world forever…
\rIn order to prevent this great calamity, those who held the knowledge of the past arrived at a plan.
\rTheir plan was to invoke Rayquaza, the great savior, and summon it to this land before the meteoroid could strike.
\rThat's the end of our…\nof the Draconids' tale.
\rI spent a long time thinking about how I could protect the happiness of as many people as possible.
\rWhat I must do, as one who holds both the knowledge and the power…
\rOne who bears the heavy wishes of those who could not…live up to that fate…
\rWell, I had to be really creative, you know?
